title: Optimizer
description: Where each agent's money goes, read from what the provider billed — and what a cheaper model would have done with the conversations it actually had.
disabledDescription: Pass studioOptimizer(...) from @gnldev/optimizer as the optimizer option of createStudioApp.
noFindings: Nothing to change on these runs.
needsReplay: Try it with a replay first
replayHelp: Plays this agent's latest runs again with the model you pick. No tool runs: every call is answered from the recording, and a call it never made stops that run as a divergence. It calls the model, so it costs money and is written to the audit log.
maskLabel: Also leave out tool output older than
reportHelp: A Markdown report of what was found, what was tried and what held. It changes nothing.
maskAfter: + old output left out after {{n}} steps
